summary: A wall enclosing and protecting a city.

senses.definition: The walls of Jerusalem are to be built and restored when Yahweh favours Zion.

note:
Drafted for Psalm 51 coverage.

Root (2026-11-21): Kept under the third-weak root חמה, with the feminine ־ָה stripped and ו as vowel letter: Arabic حَمَى "protect, guard" and حِمًى "protected place" (Lane root حمى, p. 651) give the wall as "protection".
